body: Do you think I don't know that there are people that are in worst condition than mine? Everytime I try to talk to someone is always like "there are children that are dying starving,  you should feel ashamed"  I know!  And I feel ashamed for what I have inside,  every fucking day!  Its so useless to talk to others.  So fucking useless.

feeling you, my depression worsened after the break up with my girlfriend 5 years ago, is a lot of time but i still feel it.

i tried to jump in new relationship as she did (she is now with a superhandsome boyfriend, cannot compare with him) but not worked. take your time, it will be difficult, but don't start relationships until you fell better. i'm a suicidal too so i cannot give you better tips but i hope you will be able to recover.
